name: lozenge-css
description: A Jira-flavoured, Bootstrap-style SASS component framework built on the Atlassian design token palette.

scripts.build: npm run tokens && sass scss/lozenge.scss dist/lozenge.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && sass scss/lozenge.scss dist/lozenge.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map
